title: Neil Rimer thinks the AI money is coming back out
slides: Neil Rimer predicts AI capital will exit, but where?
His Index Ventures just raised $2.3 billion for bets.
The real surprise? He is pulling funds from AI startups.
Your next fundraising round may now face harder terms.
Watch which sectors he backs next—that is your signal.
thread_text:
1. Capital leaving AI

Neil Rimer's Index Ventures just raised $2.3 billion — and he's pulling funds from AI startups.

2. Where will it go?

The money must flow somewhere. Other sectors just got a silent signal: wait and watch.

3. Your next round shifts

Terms get tougher as big capital exits. Expect harder negotiations and fewer checks.

4. Watch his next bet

Rimer's next sector move reveals where smart money lands. That's your real signal.

5. Check your runway

Does your startup have 18 months of cash? If not, adjust your fundraising strategy this week.
